entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included in messages when the network wishes to transmit protocol data to the UE, such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events. It is used when both the UE and network support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Protocol data transmission to UE
entities.description: Procedure where the network transmits protocol data to the UE using extended protocol configuration options.

entities.name: Extended PCO supported end-to-end
entities.description: Condition that both UE and network support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: The protocol data transmission procedure includes the extended protocol configuration options IE when transmitting data to the UE.
The protocol data transmission procedure using extended protocol configuration options is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support it end-to-end.
